mvp_description: AI Property Assessment tool targeting Ashtabula County Land Reutilization Corporation (Land Bank)

top_buyers.name: Ashtabula County Land Reutilization Corporation
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Primary target entity. Verified 501(c)(3) nonprofit government-related organization with EIN 47-1129824. Manages inventory of vacant, abandoned, and tax-foreclosed properties in Ashtabula County. Received $609,000 through Demolition and Site Revitalization Program in 2023. Directly aligned with the AI Property Assessment tool's purpose for parcel analysis.

decision_makers.name: Alex Iarocci
decision_makers.title: Executive Director
decision_makers.notes: Executive Director since March 2022. Primary contact for technology adoption decisions. Cleveland State University education.

decision_makers.name: Dawn Cragon
decision_makers.title: County Treasurer / Board Member
decision_makers.notes: Ashtabula County Treasurer, serves on Land Bank Board of Directors

top_buyers.name: Cuyahoga County Land Reutilization Corporation (Cuyahoga Land Bank)
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Largest and most technologically advanced land bank in Ohio. Based in Cleveland, serving Cuyahoga County. Known for innovative property management and large-scale demolition programs. Would benefit from AI assessment tools for their extensive property portfolio. Model organization for regional land bank technology adoption.

additional_contacts.name: Regrid (Formerly Loveland Technologies)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Nationwide property data and mapping platform. Provides parcel data for Ohio including Ashtabula County. Potential integration partner for enhancing ParcelVisor with comprehensive parcel data layers.

additional_contacts.name: Ohio Housing Finance Agency (OHFA)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: State agency that funds land bank activities. Technology investments align with OHFA's mission of neighborhood revitalization. Potential advocate for statewide adoption across Ohio's 51+ county land banks.
